# Committed fixtures (generated media, no third-party content)

These two files are the only committed media fixtures. The FFmpeg upgrade spec §8.2 allows them
because the shipped build cannot encode them (no libmp3lame; no software H.264 encoder), while the
differential corpus and the decoder tests still need the formats.

Both were generated on 2026-11-25 with the pinned development FFmpeg
`ffmpeg version n8.1.3-41-ga8029b6528-20261124` (LGPL, `~/.local/toolchains/ffmpeg-8.1-lgpl`) on
Windows 11, then committed. They contain only synthetic content (`sine`, `testsrc2`).

## `sine_48k.mp3` — 33,044 bytes

```
ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -y -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=2" \
  -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact sine_48k.mp3
```

BLAKE3 is recorded by the differential baseline (`tests/baseline/ffmpeg-8.1.3.json`); SHA-256:
`159f2699ba26a7ba9938d4e35c3e7dbb426c6054acaa8c796f50cd92d636d634`.

## `counter_h264_qsv.mp4` — 77,504 bytes

```
ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=30:duration=2" \
  -c:v h264_qsv -bf 2 -g 30 -pix_fmt nv12 -fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact \
  counter_h264_qsv.mp4
```

H.264 with B-frames and a 1 s GOP, encoded by the Intel Quick Sync encoder on the reference
machine (hardware encoders are not reproducible across machines, hence the committed file).
SHA-256: `b26bbb36239acae6994833aefa51d452fa82680f5c6b71a958cf1adfeb08b828`.

The full differential corpus (lossless video, MPEG-2/MPEG-4, Opus/AAC/FLAC/WAV, the F-02/J and
F-03/K fixtures, broken files) is generated by `crates/arc-media/tests/support/mod.rs` and kept
outside the repository (step 1 baseline: `~/.local/toolchains/arcline-corpus-8.1.3`), because the
spec does not allow committing it. The baseline records each file's BLAKE3, so the harness refuses
to compare a modified corpus.
